### Defining functions
```{r FischerTest_OddsRation_plotting}
plot_OR <- function(results, group_to_plot, ylim = c(-2, 2)) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    filter(Comparison_Group %in% group_to_plot) %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", ""),
      log2_OR = log2(Odds_Ratio)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(Comparison, Odds_Ratio)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -1
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}

#FischerTest_fate_OddsRation_plotting

plot_Fate_OR <- function(results, ylim = c(0, 2)) {

  plot_data <- results %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(FDR < 0.05, "*", ""),
      log2_OR = log2(Odds_Ratio)
    )

  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Comparison, y = Odds_Ratio)) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      vjust = -1
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~Fate) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "HvC developmental comparison",
      y = "Odds Ratio",
      title = "KZFP enrichment by HvC DEG fate"
    )
}

#Volcano_Plot_Function

generate_volcano_plot <- function(toptable, title) {
  
  # #check for entrezid 
  # if(!"Entrez_ID" %in% colnames(toptable)) stop("Entrez_ID col not present")
  # 
  #make significance labels
  
  toptable <- toptable %>% 
    mutate(Significance = case_when(
      logFC > 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Upregulated",
      logFC < 0 & adj.P.Val < 0.05 ~ "Downregulated",
      TRUE  ~ "Not Significant"
    ))
  
  #factor significance
  toptable$Significance <- factor(
    toptable$Significance, 
    levels = c("Upregulated", 
               "Not Significant", 
               "Downregulated")
  )
  
  #count genes in each category
  upgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Upregulated")
  nsgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Not Significant")
  downgenes <- sum(toptable$Significance == "Downregulated")
  
  
  #labels for legend
  legend_lab <- c(
    paste0("Upregulated: ", upgenes),
    paste0("Not Significant: ", nsgenes),
    paste0("Downregulated: ", downgenes)
  )
  
  #colors 
  color_map <- c("Upregulated" = "blue",
                 "Not Significant" = "grey30",
                 "Downregulated" = "red")
  
  #generate volcano plots
  p <- ggplot(toptable, aes(x = logFC, 
                            y = -log10(P.Value),
                            color = Significance)) +
    geom_point_rast(alpha = 0.8, size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = color_map, 
                       labels = legend_lab,
                       breaks = c("Upregulated",
                                  "Not Significant", 
                                  "Downregulated"))  +
    xlim(-20,20) +
    labs(title = title, 
         x = expression("log"[2]*"FC"),
         y = expression("-log"[10]*"p-value")) +
    # theme_custom() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  return(p)
}



#FC_Plot_Function_sig_trajectory_No4

plot_cluster_fc_sig_trajectory_No4 <- function(gene_vector, cluster_name, top_table) {

  df <- top_table %>%
    dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_vector) %>%
    mutate(Comparisons = factor(Comparisons, levels = c(
      "Day2_vs_Day0","Day5_vs_Day2","Day15_vs_Day5","Day30_vs_Day15"
    )))

  cat(cluster_name, ":", nrow(df), "rows,",
      length(unique(df$Gene)), "unique genes\n")

  # ✅ Skip if no data
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    message(cluster_name, ": no data — skipping")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # ✅ Skip if only one comparison present
  if (length(unique(df$Comparisons)) < 2) {
    message(cluster_name, ": only one comparison — skipping stats")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Stats
  kw <- kruskal.test(logFC ~ Comparisons, data = df)

  pw_kw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(
    df$logFC,
    df$Comparisons,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )

  print(pw_kw)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Comparisons, y = logFC)) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Comparisons)) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab(" ") +
    ylab("logFC") +
    ggtitle(
      paste0(
        cluster_name,
        " Trajectroy DEG FC Comparisons\nKruskal–Wallis p = ",
        signif(kw$p.value, 3)
      )
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-2, 2)) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = rel(1.3), hjust = 0.5),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, angle = 15)
    )

  return(p)
}

#get_directional_genes

get_fc_directions <- function(traj_label, coef_name, comparison_label,
                              top_table_all, fit_obj, p_cutoff = 0.05, gene_set = NULL) {

  # ---------------------------
  # trajectory FC data
  # ---------------------------
  df_fc <- top_table_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Comparisons %in% c(
        paste0("H_", comparison_label),
        paste0("C_", comparison_label)
      )
    )

  df_dir <- df_fc %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Species = ifelse(grepl("^H_", Comparisons), "H", "C")) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Gene, Species) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(logFC = mean(logFC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Species, values_from = logFC) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(H), !is.na(C)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # KEY FILTER: DEGs in BOTH species
  # ---------------------------
  if (!is.null(gene_set)) {
    df_dir <- df_dir %>%
      dplyr::filter(Gene %in% gene_set)
  }

  # ---------------------------
  # direction classification
  # ---------------------------
  df_combo <- df_dir %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      direction = dplyr::case_when(
        H > 0 & C < 0 ~ "H_pos_C_neg",
        H < 0 & C > 0 ~ "H_neg_C_pos",
        H > 0 & C > 0 ~ "Both_pos",
        H < 0 & C < 0 ~ "Both_neg",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      direction_group = dplyr::case_when(
        H * C > 0 ~ "Same_direction",
        H * C < 0 ~ "Opposite_direction",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )

  # ---------------------------
  # output
  # ---------------------------
  list(
    all = df_combo,
    H_pos_C_neg = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "H_pos_C_neg"),
    H_neg_C_pos = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "H_neg_C_pos"),
    Both_pos = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Both_pos"),
    Both_neg = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Both_neg"),

    Same_direction = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction_group == "Same_direction"),
    Opposite_direction = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction_group == "Opposite_direction"),

    Other = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Other"),

    n_sig = length(gene_set)
  )
}

#get_directional_genes_HvC1

get_fc_directions <- function(traj_label, coef_name, comparison_label,
                                 top_table_all, fit_obj, p_cutoff = 0.05) {

  # ---------------------------
  # DE genes
  # ---------------------------
  tt <- topTable(fit_obj, coef = coef_name, number = Inf)

  sig_tt <- tt %>%
    dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < p_cutoff) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # HvC FC data
  # ---------------------------
  df_fc <- top_table_all %>%
    dplyr::filter(Comparisons == comparison_label) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

  # ---------------------------
  # classify direction
  # ---------------------------
  df_combo <- df_fc %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(sig_tt, by = "Gene") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    direction = dplyr::case_when(
      logFC.x > 0 ~ "Increased",
      logFC.x < 0 ~ "Decreased",
      TRUE ~ "No_difference"
    ),
    magnitude = abs(logFC.x)
  )

  # ---------------------------
  # output
  # ---------------------------
  list(
    all = df_combo,
    Increased = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Increased"),
    Decreased = dplyr::filter(df_combo, direction == "Decreased"),
    n_sig = nrow(sig_tt)
  )
}
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_Filtering}

combined_counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_TECount_fc.RDS")

RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

RNA_fc_repeats <- combined_counts %>% 
   filter(grepl(":", rownames(combined_counts)))

RNA_fc_TEs <- RNA_fc_repeats %>% 
  filter(grepl("LINE|SINE|LTR|DNA|Retroposon", rownames(RNA_fc_repeats)))

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(RNA_fc_TEs,log=TRUE)

chimp_samples <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

group <- chimp_samples$Cond

keep <- apply(RNA_log2cpm, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  any(
    tapply(gene_expr > 1, group, function(x) sum(x) >= 4)
  )
})

  
RNA_fc_TEs_filtered <- RNA_fc_TEs[keep, ]
```

###Cor_HeatMap
```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_Cor, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_Colors.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_RNA_fc_TEs_filtered.RDS")
 RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

colnames(counts) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(counts), metadata$Library_ID)
]

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)


######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

library(RColorBrewer)

my_breaks <- seq(0.9, 1, length.out = 101)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","blue","lightblue", "white","salmon","red","darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  main = "Chimp TEs Sample-Sample Correlation"
)

```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_PCA_PC1_PC2, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_RNA_log2cpm_TEs_filtered.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

colnames(counts) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(counts), metadata$Library_ID)
]

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(SampleName %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts), SampleName)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_order)
  )

prcomp <- prcomp(t(log2cpm), scale=FALSE, center=TRUE)
prcomp_meta <- prcomp$x %>% cbind(., metadata)
#PCA checks
#k=1

ggplot2::autoplot(
    prcomp,
    data = prcomp_meta,
    colour = "Timepoint",
    shape  = "Species",
    size   = 4,
    x = 1,
    y = 2
) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    label = prcomp_meta$CellLine,
    vjust = -0.5,
    max.overlaps = 50
  ) +
  ggtitle(
  "Chimp TE Expression PC1–PC2 \n Log2cpm > 1 in 4/7 individuals \n in at least 1 species-timepoints"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_PCA_PC1_PC2_No4, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

colnames(counts) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(counts), metadata$Library_ID)
]

counts <- counts[, !grepl("Day4", colnames(counts))]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>%
  filter(Timepoint!="Day4") 

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(SampleName %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts), SampleName)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_order)
  )

prcomp <- prcomp(t(log2cpm), scale=FALSE, center=TRUE)
prcomp_meta <- prcomp$x %>% cbind(., metadata)
#PCA checks
#k=1

ggplot2::autoplot(
    prcomp,
    data = prcomp_meta,
    colour = "Timepoint",
    shape  = "Species",
    size   = 4,
    x = 1,
    y = 2
) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    label = prcomp_meta$CellLine,
    vjust = -0.5,
    max.overlaps = 50
  ) +
  ggtitle(
  "Chimp TE Expression PC1–PC2 \n no Day4 \n Log2cpm > 1 in 4/7 individuals \n in at least 1 species-timepoints"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_Mode}
fit <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_fit.RDS")
design_int <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_design.RDS")


contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Day2_vs_Day0 = TimepointDay2,
  Day5_vs_Day2 = TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay2,
  Day15_vs_Day5 = TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5,
  Day30_vs_Day15 = TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15,
  levels = design_int
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

plotSA(fit2, main = "RNA Model")

results_summary <- decideTests(fit2,
                               adjust.method = "BH",
                               p.value = 0.05)
summary(results_summary)

saveRDS(fit2,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_fit2.RDS")
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_TopTable}
fit2 <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_fit2.RDS")

TopTables_RNA_names <- colnames(fit2$coefficients) 

TopTable_RNA_All <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(TopTables_RNA_names,function(ct) {
    
    tt <- topTable(
      fit2,
      coef = ct,
      number = Inf,
      sort.by = "p"
    )
    
    #add identifiers
    tt$Gene <- rownames(tt)
    tt$Comparisons <- ct
    
    tt
  })
)

ComparisonNames <- unique(TopTable_RNA_All$Comparisons)

saveRDS(TopTable_RNA_All,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_TopTable.RDS")
saveRDS(ComparisonNames,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_ComparisonNames.RDS")

head(TopTable_RNA_All)
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_VolcancoPlots}
ComparisonNames <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_ComparisonNames.RDS")

# Calculate global axis limits

y_limits <- range(-log10(TopTable$P.Value), na.rm = TRUE)

plot <- list()

for (n in ComparisonNames) {
  data_n <- TopTable %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Comparisons == n)

    ggplot2::xlim(x_limits) +
    ggplot2::ylim(y_limits)
}

# Print plots

  print(plot[[n]])
}
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Expression_Directionality_results_2}
  filter(direction == "Increased") %>%
  dplyr::count(Trajectory, TE_Class) %>%
  group_by(Trajectory) %>%
  mutate(Proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Trajectory = factor(
      Trajectory,
      levels = c(
        "Traj02_genes",
        "Traj25_genes",
        "Traj515_genes",
        "Traj1530_genes"
      )

  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(

    y = "Proportion of Increased TE DEGs",
    fill = "TE Class"
  ) +
  theme_classic()

  dplyr::count(Trajectory, TE_Class) %>%
```

```{r Human_TE_Expression_Data_Upload}
sample_names <- readLines("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_samples.txt")

count_tables <- lapply(sample_names, function(sample) {
  counts <- read.table(
    paste0("data/TEs/TE_Expression/", sample, ".cntTable"),
    header = TRUE,
    row.names = 1
  )

  colnames(counts) <- sample

  counts
})

combined_counts <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) {
    x <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(x), x, check.names = FALSE)
    y <- data.frame(Feature = rownames(y), y, check.names = FALSE)

    merged <- merge(x, y, by = "Feature", all = TRUE)

    rownames(merged) <- merged$Feature
    merged$Feature <- NULL

    merged
  },
  count_tables
)
```

```{r Human_TE_Expression_HeatMap, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_Colors.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_RNA_fc_TEs_filtered.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "H")

colnames(counts) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(counts), metadata$Library_ID)
]

# Reorder metadata to match the columns of counts
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts), SampleName))

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

library(RColorBrewer)

my_breaks <- seq(0.9, 1, length.out = 101)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","blue","lightblue", "white","salmon","red","darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  main = "Human TEs Sample-Sample Correlation"
)
```

```{r Human_TE_Expression_HeatMap_No4, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>%
  filter(Timepoint!="Day4") 

# Reorder metadata to match the columns of counts
metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts), SampleName))

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

library(RColorBrewer)

my_breaks <- seq(0.9, 1, length.out = 101)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","blue","lightblue", "white","salmon","red","darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  main = "Human TEs Sample-Sample Correlation"
)
```

```{r Human_TE_Expression_Model}
fit <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_fit.RDS")
design_int <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_design.RDS")


contrast_matrix <- makeContrasts(
  Day2_vs_Day0 = TimepointDay2,
  Day5_vs_Day2 = TimepointDay5 - TimepointDay2,
  Day15_vs_Day5 = TimepointDay15 - TimepointDay5,
  Day30_vs_Day15 = TimepointDay30 - TimepointDay15,
  levels = design_int
)

fit2 <- contrasts.fit(fit, contrast_matrix)
fit2 <- eBayes(fit2)

plotSA(fit2, main = "RNA Model")

results_summary <- decideTests(fit2,
                               adjust.method = "BH",
                               p.value = 0.05)
summary(results_summary)

saveRDS(fit2,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_fit2.RDS")
```

```{r Human_TE_Expression_TopTable}
fit2 <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_fit2.RDS")

TopTables_RNA_names <- colnames(fit2$coefficients) 

TopTable_RNA_All <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(TopTables_RNA_names,function(ct) {
    
    tt <- topTable(
      fit2,
      coef = ct,
      number = Inf,
      sort.by = "p"
    )
    
    #add identifiers
    tt$Gene <- rownames(tt)
    tt$Comparisons <- ct
    
    tt
  })
)

ComparisonNames <- unique(TopTable_RNA_All$Comparisons)

saveRDS(TopTable_RNA_All,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_TopTable.RDS")
saveRDS(ComparisonNames,"data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_ComparisonNames.RDS")

head(TopTable_RNA_All)
```

```{r Chimp_TE_Instances_Expression_Data_Upload}
sample_names <- readLines("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_samples.txt")

RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

# Read all TEinstance files
count_tables <- lapply(sample_names, function(sample) {
  
  counts <- read.table(
    paste0(
      "data/TEs/TECount_Instances/",
      sample,
      ".TEinstance_counts.txt"
    ),
    header = TRUE,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep annotations + count
  counts <- counts[, 1:5, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rename the count column to the sample name
  colnames(counts)[5] <- sample
  
  counts
})

# Start with annotations + first sample
combined_counts_Chimp_annotated <- count_tables[[1]]

# Add only the count column from each remaining sample
for (i in 2:length(count_tables)) {
  
  combined_counts_Chimp_annotated <- merge(
    combined_counts_Chimp_annotated,
    count_tables[[i]][, 5, drop = FALSE],
    by = "row.names",
    all = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated) <- combined_counts_Chimp_annotated$Row.names
  combined_counts_Chimp_annotated$Row.names <- NULL
}

saveRDS(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_TEInstances_fc_annotated.RDS")


dim(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated)
head(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated)
colnames(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated)

setequal(
  colnames(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated)[5:ncol(combined_counts_Chimp_annotated)],
  sample_names
)


```


```{r Chimp_TE_Instances_Data_Restructure}
combined_counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_TEInstances_fc_annotated.RDS")

RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

  filter(Species == "C")

  filter(grepl("LINE|SINE|LTR|DNA|Retroposon", class_id)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(1:4))

colnames(RNA_fc_TEs) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(RNA_fc_TEs), metadata$Library_ID)
]

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(RNA_fc_TEs,log=TRUE)

chimp_samples <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

group <- chimp_samples$Cond

keep <- apply(RNA_log2cpm, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  any(
    tapply(gene_expr > 1, group, function(x) sum(x) >= 4)
  )
})

  
RNA_fc_TEs_filtered <- RNA_fc_TEs[keep, ]

saveRDS(RNA_fc_TEs,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_fc_TEInstances.RDS")
saveRDS(RNA_fc_TEs_filtered,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_fc_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")
```

###Cor_HeatMap
```{r Chimp_TE_Instances_Correlation, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_Colors.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_fc_TEInstances.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)


######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

saveRDS(Cor_log2cpm,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_Cor_log2cpm_TEInstances.RDS")

saveRDS(Cor_metadata,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_Cor_metadata_TEInstances.RDS")
```


```{r Chimp_TE_Instances_Correlation_heatmap, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_Cor_log2cpm_TEInstances.RDS")

Cor_metadata <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/chimp_RNA_Cor_metadata_TEInstances.RDS")

library(RColorBrewer)

my_breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 101)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","blue","lightblue", "white","salmon","red","darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  main = "Chimp TE Instances Sample-Sample Correlation"
)
```

#####PCA
```{rChimp_TE_Instances_PCA_PC1_PC2, fig.height=6,fig.width=8}
ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_Colors.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TE_Expression/chimp_RNA_log2cpm_TEs_filtered.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "C")

colnames(counts) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(counts), metadata$Library_ID)
]

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)

metadata <- metadata %>%
  dplyr::filter(SampleName %in% colnames(counts)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(colnames(counts), SampleName)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = time_order)
  )

prcomp <- prcomp(t(log2cpm), scale=FALSE, center=TRUE)
prcomp_meta <- prcomp$x %>% cbind(., metadata)
#PCA checks
#k=1

ggplot2::autoplot(
    prcomp,
    data = prcomp_meta,
    colour = "Timepoint",
    shape  = "Species",
    size   = 4,
    x = 1,
    y = 2
) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_manual(values = ann_colors$timepoint_cor) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    label = prcomp_meta$CellLine,
    vjust = -0.5,
    max.overlaps = 50
  ) +
  ggtitle(
  "Chimp TE Expression PC1–PC2 \n Log2cpm > 1 in 4/7 individuals \n in at least 1 species-timepoints"
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

```

####Human

```{r Human_TE_Expression_Data_Upload}
sample_names <- readLines("data/TEs/TE_Expression/human_samples.txt")

RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "H")

# Read all TEinstance files
count_tables <- lapply(sample_names, function(sample) {
  
  counts <- read.table(
    paste0(
      "data/TEs/TECount_Instances/",
      sample,
      ".TEinstance_counts.txt"
    ),
    header = TRUE,
    row.names = 1,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # Keep annotations + count
  counts <- counts[, 1:5, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rename the count column to the sample name
  colnames(counts)[5] <- sample
  
  counts
})

# Start with annotations + first sample
combined_counts_human_annotated <- count_tables[[1]]

# Add only the count column from each remaining sample
for (i in 2:length(count_tables)) {
  
  combined_counts_human_annotated <- merge(
    combined_counts_human_annotated,
    count_tables[[i]][, 5, drop = FALSE],
    by = "row.names",
    all = TRUE
  )
  
  rownames(combined_counts_human_annotated) <- combined_counts_human_annotated$Row.names
  combined_counts_human_annotated$Row.names <- NULL
}


dim(combined_counts_human_annotated)
head(combined_counts_human_annotated)
colnames(combined_counts_human_annotated)

setequal(
  colnames(combined_counts_human_annotated)[5:ncol(combined_counts_human_annotated)],
  sample_names
)

saveRDS(combined_counts_human_annotated,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_TEInstances_fc_annotated.RDS")

```


```{r Human_TE_Expression_Data_Restructure}
combined_counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_TEInstances_fc_annotated.RDS")

RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "H")

RNA_fc_TEs <- combined_counts %>% 
  filter(grepl("LINE|SINE|LTR|DNA|Retroposon", class_id)) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-(1:4))

colnames(RNA_fc_TEs) <- metadata$SampleName[
  match(colnames(RNA_fc_TEs), metadata$Library_ID)
]

RNA_log2cpm <- cpm(RNA_fc_TEs,log=TRUE)

human_samples <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "H")

group <- human_samples$Cond

keep <- apply(RNA_log2cpm, 1, function(gene_expr) {
  any(
    tapply(gene_expr > 1, group, function(x) sum(x) >= 4)
  )
})

  
RNA_fc_TEs_filtered <- RNA_fc_TEs[keep, ]

saveRDS(RNA_fc_TEs,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_fc_TEInstances.RDS")
saveRDS(RNA_fc_TEs_filtered,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_fc_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")

```

```{r Human_RNASeq_Fitlered_TEInstances_Correlation, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
ann_colors <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/ann_Colors.RDS")
counts <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_fc_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")
RNA_Metadata <- readRDS("data/Raw_Data/concat/RNA_Metadata.RDS")

time_order <- c("Day0", "Day2", "Day4", "Day5", "Day15", "Day30")

ann_colors$timepoint_cor <- ann_colors$timepoint_cor[time_order]

metadata <- RNA_Metadata %>% 
  filter(Species == "H")

log2cpm <- cpm(counts, log=TRUE)


######Cor_HeatMap####
Cor_log2cpm <- cor(log2cpm, method = "spearman")
individual <- metadata$Individual
species <- metadata$Species
timepoint <- metadata$Timepoint
timepoint <- factor(timepoint,levels = c("Day0","Day2","Day4","Day5","Day15","Day30"))
Cor_metadata <- data.frame(
  sample_cor = colnames(Cor_log2cpm),
  species_cor = species,
  timepoint_cor = timepoint,
  individual_cor = individual
)


rownames(Cor_metadata) <- Cor_metadata$sample_cor

saveRDS(Cor_log2cpm,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_Cor_log2cpm_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")

saveRDS(Cor_metadata,"data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_Cor_metadata_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")
```


```{r Human_RNASeq_Fitlered_TEInstances_Correlation_heatmap, fig.height=10,fig.width=10}
Cor_log2cpm <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_Cor_log2cpm_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")

Cor_metadata <- readRDS("data/TEs/TECount_Instances/human_RNA_Cor_metadata_TEInstances_filtered.RDS")

library(RColorBrewer)

my_breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 101)
my_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("darkblue","blue","lightblue", "white","salmon","red","darkred"))(100)

pheatmap(
  Cor_log2cpm,
  fontsize_row = 5,
  fontsize_col = 5,
  annotation_col = Cor_metadata[, c("species_cor", "timepoint_cor", "individual_cor")],
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  color = my_colors,
  breaks = my_breaks,
  main = "Human TE Filtered Instances Sample-Sample Correlation"
)

```
